description.zh: 用于保证请求的幂等性。由客户端生成该参数值，要保证在不同请求间唯一，最大不超过64个ASCII字符。
description.en: A unique token used to ensure the idempotence of the request. The client generates this value. The value must be unique among different requests and can contain a maximum of 64 ASCII characters.

description.zh:
是否忽略集群状态，强制重启。

- true：忽略
- false（默认值）：不忽略
description.en: Specifies whether to forcefully restart the cluster regardless of the cluster status.

descriptions.zh: > 重启后，实例进入生效中（activing）状态。重启成功后，实例状态变为正常（active）。阿里云Elasticsearch支持单节点重启，节点重启分为普通重启和蓝绿重启。
descriptions.en: > After the restart, the instance enters the activating state. After the restart is complete, the instance status changes to active. Alibaba Cloud Elasticsearch supports single-node restarts. Node restarts are classified into normal restarts and blue-green restarts.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun elasticsearch restart-instance --instance-id es-cn-nif1q8auz00030000 --biz-force false --client-token 5A2CFF0E-5718-45B5-9D4D-70B3FF0000 --biz-body 1._restart_nodes_example:_restartType_:_nodeIp_,_nodes_:_es-cn-xx-data-j-0_,_blueGreenDep_:_false_2._restart_instance_example:_restartType_:_instance_,_blueGreenDep_:_false --api-version 2017-06-13 --region cn-hangzhou
